dct_description_sm: Population monitoring of small mammals and abundance dynamics of individual species are relevant zoological objectives. The studies of microtine rodents and insect-eating mammals at the interface of the areas of species are of particular significance. Climate transformations and pollution of the air basin may influence the distribution, abundance and correlation of the species. Specifically, this project seeks to identify possible effects of air pollution from  the nickel smelter on the terrestrial ecosystem in the joint Finnish, Norwegian and Russian border area
dct_title_s: Small rodents in Pasvik, Finnmark, Norway
